metadata.blurb: Coinbase Wallet is Coinbase's self-custody wallet for managing crypto, NFTs, DeFi, and dapp connections.

ref.explanation: Coinbase Wallet help says users can create or import a self-custody wallet and use a recovery phrase to move assets between self-custody wallets.
Coinbase documents Coinbase Wallet support for ENS usernames and cb.id ENS subdomains.
Coinbase Wallet's app listing describes support for buying, selling, swapping, bridging, and minting from the wallet.
Coinbase Wallet's app listing describes managing crypto and NFTs across supported networks from one wallet.
The Coinbase Wallet SDK repository describes an open protocol for connecting Coinbase Wallet to dapps.
Coinbase Wallet's consumer app source is not published as a full open-source wallet repository; the public Coinbase Wallet SDK is separate infrastructure under its own license.
Coinbase Wallet supports creating or importing wallets and managing wallet accounts in the self-custody wallet app.
The Coinbase Wallet App Store privacy label lists Diagnostics as data that may be collected but not linked to identity.
The Coinbase Wallet App Store privacy label lists Usage Data as data that may be collected but not linked to identity.
Coinbase runs a HackerOne bug bounty program for Coinbase products and security reports.
Coinbase Wallet public docs describe app-managed network access and dapp connection flows, but no embedded Ethereum L1 light-client verification path was found.
Coinbase Wallet's security page describes token approval alerts and dapp blocklist protection for malicious dapps.
Coinbase Wallet's security page describes a dapp blocklist that warns before users proceed to applications identified as dangerous.
Coinbase Wallet's security page describes token approval alerts before users complete dapp transactions.
Coinbase Wallet's security page says transaction previews estimate token-balance changes before users complete a dapp transaction.
Coinbase Wallet help documents reviewing and revoking dapp permissions and token approvals from the browser extension or mobile app.
Coinbase Wallet public docs describe the Coinbase Wallet app and service as the transaction interface; no user-selected self-hosted-node broadcast path was found.
Coinbase Wallet public release channels and app listings do not publish independently verifiable signed application artifacts for users.
Coinbase Wallet publishes app-store update notes, but no stable public wallet changelog page was found.
Coinbase Wallet does not publish reproducible build instructions for the full consumer wallet app.
